summary:
All three ratings are unanimous on the bullpen category right now, sharing an identical 3W streak and a 100-90 (53%) mark over the last 14 days — that's the one signal running hot across the board while everything else cools off. SP grading is the story to avoid: R3's starting-pitcher category is flagged cold at -5.2pts, and R1/R2 aren't far behind at 45% over the same window (86-104). With four of today's nine SP matchups featuring notable arms — Cole vs Bradish, deGrom vs Alvarez, Kirby vs Gasser — lean on trends/runs/bullpen agreement rather than SP-driven confidence. Strong-play units are bleeding across all three ratings over the last 7 and 14 days (R1 -15.0u/7d, -10.0u/14d; R2 -14.0u/-12.0u; R3 -12.0u/-13.0u), so treat any single-rating strong play today with caution unless multiple categories back it.

On the board, eight of nine games are full consensus, and the strongest average deltas cluster where the model has season-long team trust: SEA @ MIL grades out biggest (R1 +1.31, R2 +1.52, R3 +1.99) and MIL is a proven liked-team spot at 25-15 (62%) with strong plays going 14-8 for +4.0u — this is the day's premier consensus play. TOR @ TBR is the second-best alignment (R1 +0.48 to R3 +1.29) and TBR is the model's best team-when-liked anywhere on the slate: 25-10 (71%) overall, and an elite 18-5 (78%, +22.0u) on strong plays — if this game grades as a strong play, it's the single highest-confidence angle available today. STL @ CIN is the tightest consensus fade, all three ratings within a quarter-point of each other on STL, reinforcing trends+runs (54.7% combo, the best pairing in the model) as the category stack to trust there. The lone split is ATL @ CHW, where R1/R2 lean CHW but R3 flips to ATL (-0.20) — smallest deltas on the board (R2 +0.09) make this the one game to treat as a pass or line-shop rather than a model-driven play. Avoid overweighting HOU today despite the small consensus edge toward HOU (+0.43 to +0.84); HOU as a liked team has been brutal on strong plays this season at 3-8 (27%, -8.0u).
